summary: T1 item 10 (repo hygiene): bound to the CI workflow .github/workflows/signoff.yml, which re-grades this manifest and re-verifies every pinned evidence hash on every push and pull request (signoff/verify-report.py). Audited alongside it: README.md states what the block is, carries the ratified target-spec table with its basis citations (spec/decision-records/0002, 0003 and later records), and points to evidence reproduction; LICENSE (Apache-2.0) is committed. 'pass' asserts those three are present; only the workflow's bytes are bound, so an edit to the workflow (including a grader-pin move) requires refreshing this envelope.
